headline: OpenAI推新模型Astra
context: OpenAI發布新一代模型「GPT-6 Astra」，主打電腦與瀏覽器操作能力，並非單純聊天機器人。這款模型在OSWorld V2-Offline基準測試中拿下72.6%的成績，也是OpenAI首款觸及「重大」（Critical）網路安全門檻的模型，使用資格因此受到限制。

sources.name: TechCrunch
sources.summary: OpenAI claims that Astra represents "a new frontier on computer and browser use," and that it handles tasks with unmatched "speed, accuracy, and safety."
sources.title: OpenAI launches Astra, its powerful (and controversial) new model

sources.name: Wired
sources.summary: OpenAI leaders think the company’s next generation model, which excels at computer use and coding, may mark a major milestone in AI development.
sources.title: GPT-6 Astra Is Here—and OpenAI Thinks It May Kick Off the AGI Era

sources.name: MarkTechPost
sources.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra on September 3, 2026, positioning it as a computer-use flagship rather than a chat model. It reports 72.6% on OSWorld V2-Offline, replaces Codex compaction with searchable notes, and ships a 1.05M-token context at $10/$50 per million tokens. It is also the first OpenAI model to cross the Critical cybersecurity threshold, which shapes who can use it and for what. The post OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra: A 1.05M-Context Computer-Use Model Gated Behind a ‘Critical’ Cyber Threshold appeared first on MarkTechPost .

thread_text:
OpenAI發布新一代模型「GPT-6 Astra」，主打電腦與瀏覽器操作能力，公司形容它代表「電腦與瀏覽器操作的新前沿」，並非單純的聊天機器人。這款模型在OSWorld V2-Offline基準測試拿下72.6%的成績，支援達105萬token的超長內容窗口，收費為每百萬token 10到50美元。它也是OpenAI首款觸及「重大」（Critical）網路安全門檻的模型，使用資格因此受到限制。OpenAI內部甚至認為，這可能是AGI時代的起點。

—— 本則整理自 TechCrunch、Wired 與 MarkTechPost 於 2026 年 9 月 4 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: OpenAI推出了新模型，這次主打的不是聊天，是電腦操作能力。這款新模型叫Astra，官方說它代表電腦與瀏覽器操作的新前沿。在一項基準測試裡，它拿下72.6%的成績，內容窗口長達105萬token。這也是OpenAI第一款觸及「重大」網路安全門檻的模型，使用資格因此受到限制。公司內部甚至認為，這可能是AGI時代的起點。
